Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
SINDH LAND REVENUE
(ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance to
abolish the land revenue in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2000]
No. S. LEGIS. 1(3)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Land Revenue
(Abolition) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
SINDH LAND REVENUE
(ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance to
abolish the land revenue in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2000]
No. S. LEGIS. 1(3)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Definitions. --(i)
"Act" means the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967.
(ii) "land
revenue" means the land revenue is defined in the Act.

Abolition of revenue

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
SINDH LAND REVENUE
(ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance to
abolish the land revenue in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2000]
No. S. LEGIS. 1(3)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Abolition of revenue.--Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Act or any other law for the time being in force, no
land revenue shall be charged from Kharif, 1999-2000.

Savings

ORDINANCE III OF 2000
SINDH LAND REVENUE
(ABOLITION) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE III OF 2000
An Ordinance to
abolish the land revenue in the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2000]
No. S. LEGIS. 1(3)/2000, dated
17-5-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
4. Savings.--Nothing
contained in this Ordinance shall be construed to affect the liability of any
person to pay the land revenue which became due before Kharif, 1999-2000 or the
Assessment, charge and collection of the land revenue for the period before
Kharif, 1999, which shall continue to be assessed, charged and collected under
the Act.
